name: org.opencovenant/mizuki
title: Mizuki
description: Fixed-price maintenance for public GitHub issues, paid in USDC on Solana.

environmentVariables.name: MIZUKI_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Mizuki API base URL. Defaults to the public service.

environmentVariables.name: MIZUKI_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Maintainer API token. Only needed for repository, preflight, and payment-status tools; quoting and public reads work without it.
